messages:
mika: quick copy check — tooltip for the rollout slider label 'Canary weight'. usability tests show people aren't sure what it does. posting two options, pls quick thumbs/edits

mika: ```Option A:
Canary weight — Percentage of incoming traffic routed to the canary. In-flight requests continue on the previous version; new requests use the canary immediately. Set to 0% to stop the canary.

Option B (short):
Canary weight — How much incoming traffic is routed to the canary. In-flight requests finish on the old version. Set to 0% to disable.```

anya: I like A for clarity but avoid 'previous' vs 'old' inconsistency. 'stop the canary' sounds blunt. maybe: 'Set to 0% to stop routing to the canary.' :thinking:

sam: accessibility nit — keep tooltip under ~140 chars for screen readers. also add aria-label suggestion: `aria-label="Canary traffic weight"`.

tariq: infra note: in-flight requests are drained (we wait up to ~30s then force-close), so say 'finish on the previous version (drained within ~30s)'. avoid promising long drains.

mika: new draft combining feedback:
```Canary weight — Percentage of incoming traffic routed to the canary. Existing in-flight requests finish on the previous version (drained within ~30s). New requests use the canary. Set to 0% to stop routing to the canary.```

anya: LGTM but trim a bit: remove 'New requests use the canary' (implied) and change to 'disable the canary' for brevity.

sam: shortened version for accessibility: ```Canary weight — Percent of incoming traffic routed to the canary. In-flight requests finish on the previous version (drained within ~30s). Set to 0% to disable the canary.```

designbot: micro-suggestion for tooltip length: ```Canary weight — % of incoming traffic routed to canary. In-flight requests finish on the previous version (drained within ~30s). Set to 0% to disable.```

mika: perfect — pushing the last variant into the UI and adding the aria-label Sam suggested. thanks! :raised_hands:
